maria-enginfra: FYI noticed a weird jump in monthly egress for cloud-storage this morning, ~+28% vs baseline. billing dashboard: https://billing.internal/reports/egress?month=2026-02 :eyes:
raj-finops: Oof. Can you narrow to service or prefix? Is this network egress vs inter-region object copy?
kevin-sre: I pulled the billing export — most of the delta looks like OBJECT_COPY bytes between us-west1 <-> europe-west3. Rough breakdown: 72% cross-region storage egress, 18% logs export, rest small.
anna-ops: That rings a bell — our model-artifacts CI job copies final checkpoints to eu for low-latency inference. Last change: we added a parallel rsync in the post-build hook two weeks ago. Cron name: model-sync-eu.
maria-enginfra: huh, we also turned on verbose Storage access logs for debugging during that period. Combined with repeated copies could explain it. Any quick query we can run to confirm which object prefixes?
kevin-sre: Run this BigQuery on billing export to get object prefixes and bytes (snippet):
```
SELECT REGEXP_EXTRACT(resource.labels.bucket_name, r"^([^-]+)") as bucket,
       protopayload_auditlog.request.metadata.requestAttributes["objectName"] as object,
       SUM(IFNULL((protoPayload.serviceData.jobCompletedEvent.job.outputBytes,0),0)) as bytes
FROM `org_billing.gcs_export_*`
WHERE invoice_month = "2026-02"
  AND protopayload_auditlog.methodName = "storage.objects.copy"
GROUP BY bucket, object
ORDER BY bytes DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
raj-finops: If it is model checkpoints we should treat them as high cardinality large objects — compression + lifecycle should help. Quick mitigation: can we pause the EU sync until we have a plan? That would stop additional egress this billing cycle.
anna-ops: I can toggle the flag in CI to disable model-sync-eu for the next 7 days. Will that require a deploy? It's just a feature flag in pipeline config.
maria-enginfra: please pause it. I'll run the BigQuery and post top offending prefixes in ~30m. Also we should check whether the copies used public egress vs VPC internal copy (we expect inter-region egress billed if outside same multi-region).
audit-bot: billing-alert: storage_egress > 15% baseline. Triggered at 2026-02-18T08:12:23Z.
kevin-sre: Long term recommendations: 1) use regional replication (replication policy in same cloud provider region) or set up internal VPC peering + direct region replication to avoid public egress charges, 2) add lifecycle rules to delete old checkpoints after N days, 3) use archive/compressed tar + delta-sync (rsync --checksum) to reduce bytes, 4) move logs export to lower-frequency batch.
raj-finops: Also open a support case with cloud vendor to confirm whether some copies were charged as internet egress (misconfigured endpoint) — sometimes signed URL usage or external IPs cause public egress.
maria-enginfra: results from query (top 3 prefixes):
- models/checkpoints/resnet-v2/2026-02-10-* -> 1.8TB egress
- models/checkpoints/bert-large/2026-02-* -> 900GB
- models/embeddings/* -> 420GB
looks like the rsync pattern matches resnet job.
anna-ops: confirmed: model-sync-eu was doing a full copy of the entire artifacts dir instead of incremental. my bad — pipeline change used `aws s3 cp --recursive` instead of `aws s3 sync`.
raj-finops: OK pause and apply lifecycle + sync fix. Estimate savings if we stop full copies: projected -$4.2k for next month. Please put numbers in the ticket.
kevin-sre: I'm creating ENGINFRA-1129 to track: pause sync, add lifecycle rule (30d), switch to delta sync + gzip artifacts, verify replication path (internal/regional), open cloud billing support. I'll post the ticket link.
deploy-bot: pipeline: model-sync-eu disabled by anna-ops at 2026-02-18T09:05:12Z :white_check_mark:
maria-enginfra: thanks all. Action items: (1) anna to fix pipeline (sync + compress) and reenable with canary, (2) kevin to add lifecycle rule + vendor case, (3) raj to update cost projection and notify finance.
kevin-sre: ticket created ENGINFRA-1129 https://tracker.internal/ENGINFRA-1129 — assigning to anna & kevin.
raj-finops: will prepare a short note for finance to explain spike and mitigation plan. :memo:
anna-ops: will update pipeline today, will comment in ticket when done.
maria-enginfra: closing the thread for now — reopen if more anomalies after fixes. :slightly_smiling_face:
